big_picture: Execute Programme #393 as a chronological, auditable optimization campaign for reproducible one-month net trading return. #474 rejected its frozen jump-by-curve selector. #475 then completed the governed full-history pre-2023 prequential successor and found no architecture that cleared all frozen anti-false-edge gates; the broad always-short lane remains an unconfirmed structural-premium lead, while protected 2023+ remains sealed.
why_zoomed_in: #474 showed that a profitable Block-1 jump-by-curve selector did not generalize under untouched Blocks 2-4 execution stress, while broad short exposure remained a strong lead. #475 therefore decomposed structural short exposure, simple trend/curve baselines, model challengers, causal adaptation and risk-veto roles in one frozen chronological pre-2023 traversal rather than rescuing #474.
tested_role_target_horizon: Through #475, the programme has evaluated the complete eligible July-2010 through December-2022 pre-2023 chronology under one committed prequential design. No candidate passed every frozen robustness gate. Always-short produced strong raw after-cost returns but failed multiplicity-adjusted evidence; the adaptive path and all more-complex parent-relative additions failed promotion.

historical_facts.observed: #459 promoted a joint development policy at +0.324275 percentage points/month mean outer improvement; #429 found no promoted static lifecycle variant but confirmed material contribution from strength gating, loss cooldown and the long specialist veto; #430 promoted state-dependent sizing at +0.1276375 percentage points/month; #431 selected decay20 at +0.4456875 percentage points/month versus fixed adaptation but the advantage failed under every tested one-session execution delay. #474 then froze two jump-by-curve short-vs-flat candidates and scored untouched chronological Blocks 2-4: both produced +4.935% base at 1.5 contracts but -5.25% moderate and -7.68% severe; Candidate B never differed from A, while always-short returned +27.0075% severe. #475 then traversed all 3,072 eligible pre-2023 rows from a committed freeze: always-short returned +112.775% base and +112.745% severe, but failed the multiplicity gate; the adaptive learned path returned -16.55% base and -3.04% severe, and no architecture passed all gates.
historical_facts.rules_out: The completed evidence rules out the exact failed static lifecycle variants, the tested incremental Stage-2 risk controls, and claims that the selected #431 adaptation is robust to a full-session execution delay. It does not permit protected-confirmation or paper claims. The exact #474 A/B state-selection thesis is rejected or materially weakened because it failed the pre-frozen stress/benchmark gates on chronological research-OOS; no rescue tuning is authorized. #475 additionally rules out promotion of the exact tested prequential candidate tree: none of the trend/curve, TimesFM/Kronos, volatility/jump-veto, long, legacy-V3 or adaptive constructions established a gate-passing parent-relative edge on the consumed 2010-2022 chronology.
historical_facts.does_not_rule_out: A durable structural short premium is not ruled out: the always-short lane was economically strong and recurrent but statistically unconfirmed under the frozen multiplicity rule. Scientifically distinct mechanisms, genuinely new PIT information, and later independent confirmation may still add value, but #475 itself may not be rescue-tuned and protected 2023+ remains sealed.

useful_secondary_observations: The #459 repository-wide advantage map distinguishes empirical negatives from underpowered, role-unidentifiable, source/data-held, untested and positive clues; non-promotion is not automatically evidence of no information.
#429 contribution ablations show the promoted parent materially depends on strength gating and loss cooldown, with a smaller positive long-specialist-veto contribution.
#430 shows that changing exposure can create value conditionally, while uniform fixed scaling is exposure amplification rather than a new source of directional information.
#431 shows a sharp timing boundary: same-session cost/roll/missed-fill stresses preserve the adaptation increment, while a one-session delay removes it.
#474's B-only low-jump/backwardation leg never activated in Blocks 2-4, so the broader interaction rule supplied zero incremental OOS value over Candidate A.

#475 separated raw broad-short economics from selection value: always-short dominated the tested complex children, while the adaptive learned path lost money and no child established positive robust parent-relative severe edge.
remaining_untested_roles: Whether the strong 2010-2022 always-short result reflects a durable structural Henry Hub short premium, a historical regime mix, roll/carry exposure, or another market-beta effect
Whether a scientifically distinct causal mechanism using genuinely new or newly admitted PIT information can add value over broad short exposure without reusing #475 as confirmation
Whether a future independently authorized confirmation boundary supports or rejects the broad-short structural-premium lead
Final simplification and champion freeze under #414 only after a successor, if authorized, clears its own frozen evidence gates
revisit_trigger: Do not reopen or rescue #474 or #475 from their observed historical outcomes. Re-enter only through a scientifically distinct successor with explicit evidence reclassification, a new pre-outcome freeze, and an evaluation boundary appropriate to that successor. Protected 2023+ confirmation remains sealed until separately authorized.
programme_interpretation: #475 found no sufficiently robust promoted edge in its frozen 13-lane prequential tree. Broad always-short exposure is the strongest remaining research lead because its raw base/severe economics were positive and recurrent, but it failed the multiplicity gate and is not a champion. The tested adaptive/state-selection additions did not improve robustly on simpler parents.
selection_basis: #475 is exploratory full-history research over consumed pre-2023 evidence, not fresh confirmation. The adaptive procedure, candidate tree, memories, cadences, costs, risk gates and stopping rules must be committed before traversal. Selection is the smallest architecture that shows recurring parent-relative severe-stress edge with drawdown, concentration, negative-control and multiplicity gates; protected 2023+ remains a separate later confirmation.
